summary.operator_answer: KIS can become the KR primary operational data source, but the current safe state is KIS-first test mode plus sidecar collection, not unconditional production default.
summary.prior_readiness_verdict: KR 운영 전체를 지금 KIS로 일괄 전환하면 안 된다. 먼저 KIS를 단계적 보강 데이터 소스로 써야 한다.
summary.source_only_change: The implementation keeps scanner/planner decisions unchanged by default and changes only optional source adapters behind explicit environment toggles.
